summary: @almereyda My shared host uses Apache, I won't be of much help. I do have to change permissions after updates sometime when I get a 500 error. I paste " find . -type f | xargs -i{} chmod 644 {}" into terminal works.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @almereyda My shared host uses Apache, I won't be of much help. I do have to change permissions after updates sometime when I get a 500 error. I paste " find . -type f | xargs -i{} chmod 644 {}" into terminal works.
